Probe re-run independently at --std 2002 and 2023: FULL drew 'COBOL1560: the FULL clause' at both, exit 65, also with an out-of-range FOREGROUND-COLOR 8 and FULL on a numeric-edited USING item; the twin's witness diagnostics/a42-screen-full.json has refuse-at 2002. No 2002 form, operand or enumeration case escapes the refusal, so the 2023 row's evidence covers the whole 2002 scope.
